about_the_game:
BabyKings is a chaotic 2D cooperative puzzle adventure where teamwork isn’t just helpful—it’s absolutely essential! Up to 8 players take control of royal babies trapped in a mysterious, ever-changing dungeon. Your goal? Escape! But it won’t be easy.

Each level is filled with tricky puzzles, deadly traps, and mischievous enemies that will test your coordination, reflexes, and sense of humor. Whether you're pushing blocks, activating pressure plates, or launching your friends across gaps, success only comes when you work together.

Featuring:

  • Online Co-op for 2–8 players

  • 24+ handcrafted levels in the free demo, and 60+ levels in the full release

  • Every level brings something new, with unique layouts, mechanics, and surprises to keep your team thinking

  • Adorable chaos – crown-wearing infants bouncing off walls, dodging spikes, and sometimes... each other!

Whether you're a strategic thinker or a chaotic helper, BabyKings 👑 is all about laughing, failing, retrying—and ultimately conquering the dungeon with your royal crew.
